summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return for the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, disclosing share repurchases for cancellation during March-April 2026. The filing details 19 batches of open-market buybacks totaling ~12.3M shares at prices from ~US$6.57 to ~US$7.14 per share, representing 0.036%-0.078% of issued shares per trade. These are ongoing capital-return repurchases, not a formal tender offer. As a Cayman-incorporated foreign private issuer with weighted voting rights, the company returns capital to shareholders via these buybacks. Watch for continued repurchase activity and eventual cancellation effects on share count.
